## About
B & T Tire Repair Inc is a tire shop at 5600 NW 2nd Ave in Miami. We repair tires, plug tires and sell used tires.
We open early every day, Sunday included, so you can call us when a flat catches you off guard. Our customers have given us a 4.4 rating across 127 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tire repair: Bring your tire to our shop and we'll take a look.
- Tire plugs: One reviewer had us plug the tire on their 7 series and called it quick and clean.
- Used tires: We carry used tires for drivers who need a replacement.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring in a flat early on a Sunday?
A: Yes. Give us a call and bring it over. One reviewer called early on a Sunday morning and was told to come right in.

Q: What are your hours Monday through Saturday?
A: Monday through Saturday we're open 7 AM to 8 PM.
